boundary: First acceptance prompt only; subsequent human prompts excluded.

actions.name: board.via.create
actions.description: Create vias (through/blind/buried/micro) at positions or in the pads of a footprint (via-in-pad), with drill/diameter and IPC-4761 filled/capped/plugged/covered settings; every via is read back and checked.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

actions.name: board.plane.build
actions.description: Build a verified plane for ANY net: create a net-bound zone on the given layers, fill it, require real filled copper on every layer, no unconnected pads/vias and a zone-aware connectivity proof; optionally mark the inner layers as power. An unverified plane is removed (keepOnFailure=false) so no fake pour remains.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

actions.name: board.rule_area.create
actions.description: Create a named rule area (keepout and/or region for custom rules such as T1/T2) from outline points, a box, or a footprint's bounding box/pads plus margin; read back to verify name, layers and keepout flags.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

actions.name: board.rules.region.set
actions.description: Write named custom DRC rules scoped to a rule area (A.insideArea('T1')): clearance, track width, via diameter, hole size, annular width, hole clearance, or raw rules[]; same-name rules are replaced, then read back.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

actions.name: board.drc.live
actions.description: Native KiCad DRC of the OPEN board including unsaved edits (KiCad saves a temporary copy with its project rules; kicad-cli checks it). Configurable timeoutMs; the same as board.drc.run with document instead of input.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

actions.name: board.dfm.full
actions.description: Full DFM pass: narrow tracks, off-45° and zero-length segments, dangling track stubs, acute junctions and wrongly mirrored silk text. fix=true widens tracks, removes stubs (restored if connectivity gets worse) and corrects silk mirroring, then re-analyzes.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

actions.name: board.route.length_match
actions.description: Length-match a group of nets: measure, choose the target (targetMm or the longest), serpentine-tune the short nets and re-measure; passes only if every net is within toleranceMm. Dry-run unless apply=true.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)
